## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation is updated when public behavior changes
- [ ] No raw secrets, prompts, source files, or tool outputs are captured by default
- [ ] Changes that expand authority, retained data, or automatic side effects update `docs/THREAT_MODEL.md`

## Security impact

Describe changes to trust boundaries, authorization, evidence, cryptography, persistence, or external effects. Write `None` only when none apply.
